note: GD.42 include-style mounts, Hono (documenso's shape, apps/remix/server/router.ts). api/files/files.ts exports a chained `new Hono().post('/upload-pdf', ..).get('/item/:id', ..)` whose verb lines continue the declaration; api/auth.ts chains a sub-app in with `.route('/', session)`; router.ts, an app with a non-literal `basePath`, mounts both with `app.route('/svc/files', filesRoute)` / `app.route('/svc/auth', auth)` by imported name. The client calls non-`/api` prefixes, so only the mount pairs them. Baseline (pre-change CLI, glia 0.5.5+p1f568a19): ROUTEs `POST /upload-pdf`, `GET /item/:id`, `GET /session`, `POST /sign-out`, `[http] paired=0`.
